name: Tailwinds Academy
summary: Philadelphia flight school that says it is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit and lists wet rates for four aircraft.
differentiator: Bases its $23,000 to $28,000 private pilot estimate on about 80 flight hours and 90 instruction hours, more than the 40 to 65 hours most other estimates here assume, and lists the extras separately.
pricing: Cessna 172N at $225 to $235 an hour wet, Cessna 150L at $165, instructor $90 an hour.

estimate.hoursBasis: about 80 flight hours and 90 instruction hours
estimate.note: The page gives a range of $23,000 to $28,000.

bestFor: Students who want a nonprofit school and a budget that lists the extras.
skipIf: You are comparing the lowest hourly rate; its Cessna 172N rates are among the higher ones published here.
watchOut: Its $225 to $235 Cessna 172N rates are higher than several others in this set.
